mapper.select: SELECT D.DIARY_NO AS diaryNo , D.DIARY_TITLE AS diaryTitle , SUBSTR( D.DIARY_CONTENT,0 ,40)||'...' AS diaryContent , D.DIARY_STATUS AS diaryStatus , TO_CHAR(D.CREATED_DATE,'YYYY.MM.DD') AS createdDate , D.UPDATED_DATE AS updatedDate , D.COUNT AS count , M.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo , M.MEMBER_NAME AS memberName , S.SCHEDULE_NO AS scheduleNo , T.TRAVEL_NO AS travelNo , nvl2(img.image_url,img.image_url,'https://us.123rf.com/450wm/oculo/oculo2004/oculo200400003/143645399-no-image-available-icon.jpg') as imageUrl FROM TB_DIARY D JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON (D.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO) LEFT JOIN TB_SCHEDULE S ON (D.SCHEDULE_NO = S.SCHEDULE_NO) LEFT JOIN TB_TRAVEL T ON (D.TRAVEL_NO = T.TRAVEL_NO) LEFT JOIN TB_DIARY_IMAGE IMG ON (d.diary_no = IMG.diary_no) WHERE D.DIARY_STATUS = 'N' ORDER BY D.DIARY_NO DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_DIARY D WHERE DIARY_STATUS = 'N'

SELECT D.DIARY_NO AS diaryNo , D.DIARY_TITLE AS diaryTitle , D.DIARY_CONTENT AS diaryContent , TO_CHAR(D.CREATED_DATE,'YYYY.MM.DD') AS createdDate , D.COUNT AS count , M.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo , M.MEMBER_NAME AS memberName FROM TB_DIARY D JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON (D.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO)
WHERE D.DIARY_NO = #{diaryNo}
SELECT IMAGE_URL FROM TB_DIARY_IMAGE WHERE DIARY_NO = #{diaryNo}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM rn, A.* FROM ( SELECT C.COMMENT_NO AS commentNo , D.DIARY_NO AS diaryNo , C.COMMENT_CONTENT AS commentContent , M.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo , M.MEMBER_NAME AS memberName , TO_CHAR( C.CREATED_DATE, 'yyyy.mm.dd') AS createdDate FROM TB_COMMENT C JOIN TB_DIARY D ON (C.DIARY_NO = D.DIARY_NO) LEFT JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON (M.MEMBER_NO = C.MEMBER_NO) WHERE D.DIARY_NO = #{diaryNo} AND C.COMMENT_STATUS = 'N' ORDER BY C.CREATED_DATE DESC ) A ) WHERE rn BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_COMMENT WHERE DIARY_NO = #{diaryNo} AND COMMENT_STATUS = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_DIARY_IMAGE( IMAGE_NO ,IMAGE_URL ,ORIGINAL_NAME ,SORT_ORDER ,CREATE_DATE ,DIARY_NO ) VALUES (SEQ_DIARY_IMG.NEXTVAL , #{imageUrl} , #{originalName} , 1 , SYSDATE , #{diaryNo} )

SELECT SEQ_DIARY.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_DIARY (DIARY_NO, DIARY_TITLE, DIARY_CONTENT, DIARY_STATUS, CREATED_DATE, UPDATED_DATE, COUNT, MEMBER_NO, SCHEDULE_NO, TRAVEL_NO, REGION_NO, THEME_NO) VALUES (#{diaryNo}, #{diaryTitle}, #{diaryContent}, 'N', SYSDATE, SYSDATE, 0, #{memberNo}, NVL(#{scheduleNo}, 0), NVL(#{travelNo}, 0), NVL(#{regionNo}, 0), NVL(#{themeNo}, 0))
